title: Improve conditional κ to 0.00329394 by retiring an independent Gaussian
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ increases from 0.003288299 ([#6529](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6529)) to 0.00329394: an incremental gain of 0.000005641, or 0.17155%.** This excludes all inherited gains. It is below the requested 1% target.

The caller now returns one completed Gaussian at an intermediate cut and gives the remaining suffix a fresh, independent input. On each of 104 ports, one rank-17 target becomes independent rank-1 and rank-16 targets. The productive change is exactly `104(H1 + H16 − H17)`; all **67,096 paid Gaussian jobs** remain. This changes the fixed-target premise of the earlier packing ceiling.

| Complete invoice | #6529 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Independent caller fields per port | 34 | 35 |
| Productive fields, including native helpers | 13,652 | 13,756 |
| Paid Gaussian jobs | 67,096 | 67,096 |
| Full native calls / thin queries | 18 / 17 | 18 / 17 |
| Caller events | 570 | 609 |

## Proof and implementation

At event 328 of the [#6398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6398) root, explicit dual pairs isolate a central involution `S = λq⁻¹`, where `λ = (1+i)/2 + (1−i)q²/2`. Two literal ordinary basis changes separate that completed output from the suffix. The input basis mixes only three equal complete targets, so the suffix has an independent rank-16 block. A new input can enter it without copying or reusing the returned input.

Start with [PROOF.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c/research/gaussian-root-retirement/PROOF.md), the [literal construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c/research/gaussian-root-retirement/retirement.py), and [WITNESS.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c/research/gaussian-root-retirement/WITNESS.json). [RESEARCH.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c/research/gaussian-root-retirement/RESEARCH.md) records the discovery, the improved ordinary basis word, the fixed-invoice ceiling, and open questions. Every new basis gate, route, normalizer and public field is charged; the complete ordinary-work bound is 254,699,248, below the inherited 10⁹ allowance.

## Verification

- Two complete caller engines check all 1,225 coefficients over the unspecialized central ring. Exact dual-pair and basis checks, plus invalid variants, cover the retirement step.
- Full source regeneration checks all 799 native columns, 2,939 native maps, 208 main adapters and 7,488 physical contacts, with absolute phases. No cached receipt replaces these checks.
- Two rational price engines certify the tested saving `0.003293945`, the strict raw crossing bracket `(0.00329394637095319036829691, 0.00329394637095319036829692)`, the compiler, and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates.
- CPython 3.12 normal and optimized registered replays pass. Committed bytes/modes, all 39 retained source files, official export integrity and input coverage pass. Both read-only, Git-free, empty-PATH export replays pass. [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c/research/gaussian-root-retirement/VALIDATION.md) states the coverage and limits. Hosted planning and both registered replays passed at head `775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c` in [run 41578844006](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41578844006). Completed logs confirm both result markers and unchanged committed inputs.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-root-retirement
```

## Scope and credit

This is an author-checked conditional construction. The source stack includes pending PRs; its admission and independent scientific review remain open. The five inherited assumptions (`native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`) remain. No materialized rounded multiplier, runtime gain, full-history preflight in this shallow checkout, or selected-frontier change is claimed. The raw ceiling applies only to this fixed invoice.

Credit the independent-handoff method in [#5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599) and #5602/#5611/#5615; the #6348/#6398 root; the [#6529 native source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6529), including Rohan Arun's #6399/#6417 and Erwan L.'s #6453; and the [#6524 replay interfaces](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6524). Exact source bytes, hashes, Git blobs and original notices are retained. Canonical [investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19360996). Canonical main `7c49fe32`, priority revision 8 and live overlap were refreshed. This scope changes the caller boundary and leaves the native word fixed. It is separate from the active fixed-native monotone-contact and overwrite-query work. Maintainer edits are disabled; no merge or frontier update is requested.
